title: Prometheus scraper
description: Series of /metrics endpoints inside module_targets, module_hosts and module_ports (by default loopback, localhost, ports 9090-9999 among others), mapped onto sermon_prometheus_gauge and sermon_prometheus_rate with the labels name and series.

urls.title: Endpoints
urls.description: http:// or https:// URLs of /metrics, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9100/metrics.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Names to take, a trailing * for a prefix (e.g. http_requests_total, process_*); empty: all, up to the limit.

max_series.title: Series per endpoint
max_series.description: At most so many series of an endpoint, the first of the page; all endpoints together at most 250.

tls_verify.title: Verify TLS certificates
tls_verify.description: For https URLs; off only for self-signed certificates you can't give as a CA file.

ca_file.title: CA file
ca_file.description: PEM file below module_file_prefixes to verify with instead of the system's CAs.

bearer.title: Bearer token
bearer.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer to the configured endpoints only, never after a redirect to another host.
